# The Tower Vigil

## Premise
A watchman must light the signal fire before the enemy fleet rounds the cape at dawn.

## World / Characters
1. Halric, the lighthouse watchman
2. Mirel, the harbor captain

## Manuscript

### Chapter 1: The First Warning
Halric climbed the spiral stair with the oil lamp swinging in his fist. The wind clawed at the shutters and the sea below threw itself against the black rocks. He reached the lantern room and saw the dark shapes massing beyond the cape. His hands shook as he struck the flint again and again. The signal fire caught at last and roared into the night, and far below Mirel raised her horn to answer.

### Chapter 2: The Second Warning
Halric climbed the spiral stair with the oil lamp swinging in his fist. The wind clawed at the shutters and the sea below threw itself against the black rocks. He reached the lantern room and saw the dark shapes massing beyond the cape. His hands shook as he struck the flint again and again. The signal fire caught at last and roared into the storm, and high on the wall Mirel lifted her horn to reply.
